items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: I put a Dr. Suess book in the back of my pants so when she spanked me it wouldn't hurt as much.

ctx.x: That we never saw but we heard about it.

Yeah. If you get out of line, you know, “I’m going to have to take out the “wapper dapper” which was — as far as we could figure it was like a big-ass cowboy belt, that maybe had some of those little silver dollar buffalo things left in them so it would hurt extra hard. But and certainly our Grandma Myrtle — I still remember back, this relates directly. When they were gone a long time on that tour in ’58 Grandma Myrtle as the name might imply was a tall, just completely straight ahead kind of person, like the…
Was there sibling rivalry on and off? I guess musically is my question but maybe with other things?
